supply_boundary: DUT supply leads disconnected; fixed common GND retained; residual charge must settle

supported_physics.source: 50 ohm source plus external Rs=100 or 10000 ohm

diagnostic_rules: Network ranking never removes a physically compatible candidate by itself
Fit normal component tolerances using normal reference before fault diagnosis
Retain all classes explaining observed data within pre-frozen thresholds
Choose the condition of largest compatible-response variance with a small public Rs-switch cost
Freeze candidate prediction and obtain two independent confirmation observations
Unmeasured slots are masked, never treated as measured zeros
Slot P is internal VB with ADC probe raised, never dual contact on the excitation pad
Parallel-branch shorts may be indistinguishable; preserve both candidates
Lost return/loading paths may render several changes below measurement resolution
Unknown topology or active unqualified power-off circuit is rejected
